about_short_description.short_description: Magma is a software tool for learning mathematics in primary and secondary schools.

product.name: Magma Platform
product.description: A digital platform for teaching and learning mathematics in primary and secondary schools, enabling teachers to assign exercises, track student progress, and analyze handwritten student solutions.

product.name: Exercise and Assignment Creation
product.description: Tools within Magma to create, customize, and distribute math exercises and assignments to individual students, groups, or entire classes.

product.name: Student Progress Tracking and Analytics
product.description: Features that provide teachers with real-time insights into student performance, including detailed result matrices and skill reports.

product.name: Handwritten Solution Capture and Review
product.description: A feature that captures students' handwritten calculations digitally, allowing teachers to review and analyze problem-solving processes.

product.name: Pre-assessments and Diagnostics
product.description: Tools to conduct diagnostic tests and screenings to assess students' mathematical knowledge and identify learning gaps.

identifier.value: Support for Homework and Remote Learning

product.name: Support for Homework and Remote Learning
product.description: Capabilities to assign and manage math exercises for homework or distance learning, with real-time progress monitoring and support features.
